classes.name: Wood Shop 102:  Make a Picture Frame - 2 Days - $145
classes.description:
Wood Shop 102: Make a Picture Frame
 
2 Days - $145
 
Prerequisites: Wood Shop 101 or previous wood shop experience
 
The broad goal for this 2-day course is to help students cultivate the skills, knowledge, and attitudes necessary to start and troubleshoot intermediate woodshop projects.
 
The course includes the fundamental woodshop machines: Planer, Jointer, Router, and Drum Sander. Students will get hands-on experience with these tools and learn how to make a picture frame by the end of the workshop.
 

-Square a rough sawn or reclaimed piece of wood with the jointer and planer
-Set up and use a router to finish an edge
-Use the biscuit joiner to add strength to a wood joint
-Select and apply finishes to woods (teak or linseed oil)

Ages 12 and above. All youth under the age of 16 must be chaperoned by an adult also taking the class.
 
Maximum 4 students.
 

To register, click on the BOOK button. If the class is full, you can add your name to the waitlist. If there is no BOOK or WAITLIST button, the class and waitlist are full.

Cancellations made 72 hours or more in advance will receive a Roundhouse class credit. Cancellations made 72 hours or less are non-refundable and non-transferable. Roundhouse class credit may be issued for medical or family emergencies.
